verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's own docs describe a drop-in OpenAI replacement: you set `base_url` to `https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai` and `api_key` to a DeepInfra token, and existing OpenAI SDK code works. The same docs say you must also set `model` to a model from their catalog, so in practice it is not quite 'only' the base URL and key. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK compatibility, and a way to avoid changing the model name.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point an existing OpenAI SDK client at the provider by changing only the base URL and API key

citations.quote: Drop-in OpenAI replacement. Point your existing OpenAI SDK to https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai and your code works without changes.
